headline: Mastercard (MA) Expands Merchant Reach, Is The Valuation Upside Still There?
summary: Mastercard (MA) is back in focus after Fiserv announced a global partnership that connects Mastercard Merchant Cloud with Fiserv Commerce Hub, giving enterprise merchants a single connection to a broad suite of payment services. See our latest analysis for Mastercard. Mastercard’s recent partnerships in merchant services, travel rewards and stablecoin infrastructure come as the stock posts a 30 day share price return of 7.01% and a 3 year total shareholder return of 47.52%, suggesting...
